Notice Concerning the Status of the Repurchase of Shares of our Common Stock

(Repurchase of Shares under our Articles of Incorporation pursuant to Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act of Japan)

We hereby inform you of the repurchase of shares conducted in October pursuant to Article 156 of the Companies Act of Japan (the “Companies Act”) as applied pursuant to Article 165, Paragraph 3 of the Companies Act, concerning which repurchase notifications were given on August 4, 2026, as follows:

 

1. Class of shares repurchased       Shares of common stock of Toyota Motor Corporation (“TMC”)
2. Total number of shares repurchased       45,167,100 shares
3. Total purchase price for repurchase of shares       JPY 134,999,601,650
4. Period of repurchase       From October 1, 2026 to October 31, 2026
5. Method of repurchase       Open market purchases

(Reference)

      Shares of common stock of TMC

      500 million shares (maximum)
